macro_area.label: Property
macro_area.description: Describe what the property is, where it is, and how it is physically composed.

subareas.label: Property Identity and Real Estate Unit
subareas.description: Identity of the governed real-estate object and its legal or operational unit references.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the listing. The value may be identical to that of the Listing Key, but the Listing ID is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific listing. In a multiple originating system or a merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Types
dictionary_terms.description: A collection of types of units included in the income (multifamily) property. The collection includes a type, beds, baths and other aspects of the type of unit behind described.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for this record from the immediate source. This is a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the local key of the system. When records are received from other systems, a local key is commonly applied. If conveying the original keys from the source or originating systems, see SourceSystemKey and OriginatingSystemKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Number
dictionary_terms.description: A text field containing the unit number or portion of a larger building or complex that should appear following the street suffix or, if it exists, the street suffix direction in the street address (e.g., Apt G, #55).

dictionary_terms.label: Building Name
dictionary_terms.description: The marketing or vanity name of the building or complex.

dictionary_terms.label: Parcel Number
dictionary_terms.description: A number used to uniquely identify a parcel or lot. This number is typically issued by the county or county assessor. The APN (Assessor's Parcel Number) format varies from county to county. It is recommended that all parcel numbers be transmitted without dashes or hyphens.

dictionary_terms.label: Building Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the building or business park.

dictionary_terms.label: Business Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the business being sold.

dictionary_terms.label: Parcel Number
dictionary_terms.description: A number used to uniquely identify a parcel or lot. This number is typically issued by the county or county assessor. dictionary_terms.label: Property Name
dictionary_terms.description: The easily recognizable name identifying the property. The property name may be a general name or address (e.g., Pinelawn Shopping Center, 10 Broadway St.)

dictionary_terms.label: Property Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of types of properties (e.g., Residential, Lease, Income, Land, Mobile, Commercial Sale).

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of floor plans or configurations of an individual unit (e.g., 1 Bedroom, Studio, Loft) in a multi-family or multi-unit development. A relational implementation of UnitTypes must omit the type from the field name and use UnitTypeType to create a vertical representation of the various unit types. Repeating of the word "type" in the field name is intentional.

dictionary_terms.label: Property Subtype
dictionary_terms.description: A list of types of residential and residential lease properties (e.g., Single-Family Residence, Condominium, Townhouse) or a list of subtypes for mobile (e.g., Manufactured Home, Manufactured On Land).

dictionary_terms.label: Property Sub Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of types of residential and residential lease properties (e.g., Single-Family Residence, Condominium, Townhouse) or a list of subtypes for mobile (e.g., Manufactured Home, Manufactured On Land).

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Parcel Letter
dictionary_terms.description: Some systems of parcel identification incorporate a method that utilizes a county identifier, a tax book number, a tax map number and a parcel identification number.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing
dictionary_terms.description: The listing associated with the PropertyUnitType record.

dictionary_terms.label: Feed Types
dictionary_terms.description: A list of feeds that the given record is included in.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The foreign ID relating to the Property Resource; the well-known identifier for the listing. The value may be identical to that of the Listing Key, but the Listing ID is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific listing. In a multiple-originating or merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Universal Property ID
dictionary_terms.description: The Universal Property Identifier (UPI) is a unique identifier for all real property in the U.S. and Canada. It is based on country and local identification methods and is limited to real property. For cases such as shares of real property, units and other more granular cases, please utilize the UniversalPropertySubId.

dictionary_terms.label: Universal Property ID
dictionary_terms.description: The RESO Universal Property Identifier (UPI) is a unique identifier for all real property in the U.S. and Canada. It is based on country and local identification methods and is limited to real property. For cases such as shares of real property, units and other more granular cases, please utilize the UniversalPropertySubId.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Key
dictionary_terms.description: The foreign key relating to the Property Resource; a unique identifier for this record from the immediate source; a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the local key of the system. When records are received from other systems, a local key is commonly applied. If conveying the original keys from the source or originating systems, see the Property Resource's SourceSystemKey and OriginatingSystemKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for this record. This is a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the local key of the system.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of possible unit types (e.g., 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom, 3 Bedroom, Studio, Loft).

dictionary_terms.label: Landmark Name
dictionary_terms.description: The building's name as assigned by the Landmarks Preservation Commission.

dictionary_terms.label: Universal Property Sub ID
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for all subsets or shares of real property in the U.S. and Canada. This may include Stock Cooperatives, Community Apartment, Units for Rent, etc. Informally abbreviated as UPSI, it is based on country and local identification methods, just as the Universal Property Identifier (UPI), but it is limited to subsets or shares of real property. For cases of complete real property, please utilize the UniversalPropertyId field.

dictionary_terms.label: Universal Property Sub ID
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for all subsets or shares of real property in the U.S. and Canada. This may include Stock Cooperatives, Community Apartment, Units for Rent, etc. Informally abbreviated as UPSI, it is based on country and local identification methods, just as the Universal Property Identifier (UPI), but it is limited to subsets or shares of real property. For cases of complete real property, please utilize the UniversalPropertyId field.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Pro Forma
dictionary_terms.description: The pro forma rent or the expected rental income from the given type of unit. This may vary from actual rent, which can be affected by factors other than current market value.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Beds Total
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of bedrooms for a given type of unit.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Furnished
dictionary_terms.description: The level of furnishing for a given type of unit (i.e., Furnished, Partial or Unfurnished).

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Total Rent
dictionary_terms.description: The total actual rent is the sum of all rent being collected for all units of the given type. For example, if you had five units of a particular type, each collecting $1,000, the total actual rent would be $5,000.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Actual Rent
dictionary_terms.description: The actual rent per month being collected for a given type of unit.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Type Baths Total
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of baths for a given type of unit.

dictionary_terms.label: Room Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of identifiers for specific interior spaces within a structure (e.g., Bedroom, Bathroom, Kitchen, Living Room). A relational implementation of rooms must omit the type from the field name and use RoomType to create a vertical representation of the various rooms. Note that garage or basement should not be added as a room type, as these are represented by the ParkingFeatures and Basement fields, respectively.

dictionary_terms.label: Amenities

dictionary_terms.label: MLS Status
dictionary_terms.description: A local or regional status that is well known by business users. Each MlsStatus field must map to a single StandardStatus. Multiple MlsStatus fields may map to a single StandardStatus.

dictionary_terms.label: Walk Score
dictionary_terms.description: A walkability index based on the time to walk from a property to nearby essentials such as grocery stores, schools, churches, etc. See https://www.walkscore.com/ for more information and requirements for using Walk Score.

dictionary_terms.label: Public Remarks
dictionary_terms.description: Text remarks that may be displayed to the public. In an MLS, it is the field where information is entered for the public. This information is intended to be visible online and typically describes the selling points of the building and/or land for sale. Local conditions and rules will determine what such content can contain. Generally, any information pertaining to entry to the property, the seller and/or tenant, or listing member contact information is excluded. In other systems, these remarks will be determined by local business rules.

dictionary_terms.label: Green Location
